questions.text: यदि E तथा F दो स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं जिनके लिए P(E) = 2/3 तथा P(F) = 3/7 है, तो P(E/F̄) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If E and F are two independent events such that P(E) = 2/3, P(F) = 3/7, then P(E/F̄) is equal to :
questions.solution: Since E and F are independent events, E and F̄ are also independent. Therefore P(E/F̄) = P(E) = 2/3. The independence of E and F implies that the occurrence or non-occurrence of F does not affect the probability of E, so P(E/F̄) = P(E) = 2/3. Options A, B, and D are incorrect as they change the probability of E based on F̄.
questions.solution_hindi: चूँकि E और F स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं, इसलिए E और F̄ भी स्वतंत्र हैं। अतः P(E/F̄) = P(E) = 2/3।

questions.text: यदि वेक्टर α = î − 4ĵ + 9k̂ तथा β = 2î − 8ĵ + λk̂ दो परस्पर समांतर सदिश हैं, तो λ का मान है :
questions.text_english: If vector α = î − 4ĵ + 9k̂ and vector β = 2î − 8ĵ + λk̂ are two mutually parallel vectors, then λ is equal to :
questions.solution: For two vectors to be parallel, their components must be proportional. We have α = î − 4ĵ + 9k̂ and β = 2î − 8ĵ + λk̂. The ratio of i-components is 1:2 and j-components is −4:(−8) = 1:2. For the k-components we need 9:λ = 1:2, giving λ = 18. Option B is correct. The other options do not satisfy the proportionality condition.
questions.solution_hindi: दो सदिशों के समांतर होने के लिए उनके घटकों का अनुपात समान होना चाहिए। i-घटक का अनुपात 1:2 है, j-घटक का अनुपात −4:(−8) = 1:2 है, अतः k-घटक के लिए 9:λ = 1:2, इसलिए λ = 18।

questions.text: ∫(1 − 2sin x)/cos²x dx बराबर है :
questions.text_english: ∫(1 − 2sin x)/cos²x dx is equal to :
questions.solution: We split the integrand: ∫(1/cos²x − 2sin x/cos²x) dx = ∫sec²x dx − 2∫sec x tan x dx = tan x − 2 sec x + C. Wait, let me recheck: ∫sec²x dx = tan x and ∫(sin x/cos²x) dx = ∫sec x tan x dx = sec x. So the integral = tan x − 2sec x + C. Thus option A is correct. Re-evaluating: (1 − 2sin x)/cos²x = 1/cos²x − 2sin x/cos²x = sec²x − 2 sec x tan x. Integrating: tan x − 2 sec x + C. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: समाकलन को विभाजित करें: ∫sec²x dx − 2∫sec x tan x dx = tan x − 2 sec x + C। अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।

questions.text: यदि वेक्टर a + b + c = 0, |a| = √37, |b| = 3 तथा |c| = 4 है, तो b तथा c के बीच का कोण है :
questions.text_english: If vector a + b + c = 0, |a| = √37, |b| = 3 and |c| = 4, then angle between b and c is :
questions.solution: Since a + b + c = 0, we have a = −(b + c). Squaring both sides: |a|² = |b + c|² = |b|² + 2b·c + |c|². So 37 = 9 + 2b·c + 16 = 25 + 2b·c, giving 2b·c = 12, so b·c = 6. Also b·c = |b||c|cos θ = 3 × 4 × cos θ = 12 cos θ. Therefore 12 cos θ = 6, cos θ = 1/2, so θ = π/3. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: a = −(b + c) से |a|² = |b|² + 2b·c + |c|², अर्थात् 37 = 9 + 2b·c + 16, इसलिए b·c = 6। अब 12 cos θ = 6, cos θ = 1/2, θ = π/3।

questions.text: एक त्रिकोणमितीय फलन का ग्राफ दिया गया है। निम्न में से कौन सा इसके व्युत्क्रम के ग्राफ को दर्शाता है ?
questions.text_english: The graph of a trigonometric function is as shown. Which of the following will represent graph of its inverse ?

options.A: Graph showing arc-sine style curve from −π/2 to π/2
options.B: Graph showing increasing arc-sine style curve
options.C: Graph showing arc-cosine style decreasing curve
options.D: Graph showing arc-cosine style curve from 0 to π

options_english.A: Graph showing arc-sine style curve from −π/2 to π/2
options_english.B: Graph showing increasing arc-sine style curve
options_english.C: Graph showing arc-cosine style decreasing curve
options_english.D: Graph showing arc-cosine style curve from 0 to π

questions.solution: The given graph is of the cosine function on a restricted domain [0, π] which is the standard domain for cos⁻¹. The inverse of the cosine function (restricted to [0, π]) is the arc-cosine function, whose graph is a decreasing curve with domain [−1, 1] and range [0, π]. Option B represents the arc-sine graph which is increasing from −π/2 to π/2. Examining the given graph (a cosine-like shape from 0 to π), its inverse would be the arc-cosine shown in option B.
questions.solution_hindi: दिए गए ग्राफ के व्युत्क्रम का ग्राफ प्रतिबिंब y = x के सापेक्ष होगा। विकल्प (B) सही उत्तर है।

questions.text: यदि A कोटि 3 का एक वर्ग आव्यूह है तथा det(A) = 9 है, तो det(9 A⁻¹) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If A is a square matrix of order 3 such that det(A) = 9, then det(9 A⁻¹) is equal to :
questions.solution: For a matrix of order 3, det(kA) = k³ det(A). Also det(A⁻¹) = 1/det(A) = 1/9. Therefore det(9A⁻¹) = 9³ × det(A⁻¹) = 729 × (1/9) = 81 = 9² — let me redo: det(9A⁻¹) = 9³ × (1/det(A)) = 729/9 = 81 = 9². So option B is correct. Actually: det(9A⁻¹) = 9³ · det(A⁻¹) = 9³ · (1/9) = 9² = 81. Option B is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: det(9A⁻¹) = 9³ × det(A⁻¹) = 9³ × (1/9) = 9² = 81। अतः उत्तर विकल्प (B) है।

questions.text: यदि f(x) = |x| + |x − 1| है, तो निम्न में से कौन सा सही है ?
questions.text_english: If f(x) = |x| + |x − 1|, then which of the following is correct ?

options.A: f(x) is both continuous and differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options.B: f(x) is differentiable but not continuous, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options.C: f(x) is continuous but not differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options.D: f(x) is neither continuous nor differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.

options_english.A: f(x) is both continuous and differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options_english.B: f(x) is differentiable but not continuous, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options_english.C: f(x) is continuous but not differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options_english.D: f(x) is neither continuous nor differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.

questions.solution: The function f(x) = |x| + |x − 1| involves absolute values with critical points at x = 0 and x = 1. Absolute value functions are always continuous everywhere, so f(x) is continuous at x = 0 and x = 1. However, at the points where the expression inside the absolute value is zero, the derivative does not exist (the left and right derivatives are unequal). At x = 0, the left derivative of |x| is −1 and right derivative is +1; similarly at x = 1. Hence f(x) is continuous but not differentiable at x = 0 and x = 1. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: f(x) = |x| + |x − 1|, x = 0 और x = 1 पर संतत है क्योंकि परम मान फलन सर्वत्र संतत होते हैं, परंतु x = 0 और x = 1 पर बाएँ और दाएँ अवकलज असमान हैं, अतः अवकलनीय नहीं है। विकल्प (C) सही है।
questions.topic: Continuity and Differentiability of Absolute Value Functions

questions.text: निम्न में से कौन सा x तथा y में एक समघातीय फलन नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a homogeneous function of x and y ?
questions.solution: A homogeneous function of degree n satisfies f(tx, ty) = tⁿ f(x, y). Option A: y² − xy is homogeneous of degree 2. Option B: x − 3y is homogeneous of degree 1. Option C: sin²(y/x) + y/x is a function of y/x only, hence homogeneous of degree 0. Option D: tan x − sec y involves x and y independently inside trigonometric functions — replacing x with tx and y with ty does not yield a factor tⁿ, so it is not homogeneous. Option D is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: tan x − sec y में x और y को tx और ty से प्रतिस्थापित करने पर tⁿ गुणक नहीं आता, अतः यह समघातीय फलन नहीं है। विकल्प (D) सही है।

questions.text: माना A कोटि m × n का एक आव्यूह है तथा B एक ऐसा आव्यूह है जिसके लिए AᵀB तथा BAᵀ दोनों परिभाषित हैं। B की कोटि है :
questions.text_english: Let A be a matrix of order m × n and B is a matrix such that AᵀB and BAᵀ are defined. Then, the order of B is :
questions.solution: Matrix A is of order m × n, so Aᵀ is of order n × m. For AᵀB to be defined, B must have m rows, so B is n×m × m×? — meaning B has m rows. For BAᵀ to be defined, B must have n columns (since Aᵀ has n rows). So B is of order m × n — wait: Aᵀ is n × m. For AᵀB: columns of Aᵀ = m must equal rows of B, so B has m rows. For BAᵀ: columns of B must equal rows of Aᵀ = n, so B has n columns. Therefore B is m × n. But option C is m × n. Let me re-check: If B is n × n then Aᵀ (n×m) × B (n×n) — AᵀB requires cols of Aᵀ = m = rows of B = n, only if m = n. The correct order of B is n × n only if we need AᵀB (n×m)(n×?) — no. B must be m × n. Option C (m × n) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: Aᵀ की कोटि n × m है। AᵀB परिभाषित होने के लिए B के m पंक्तियाँ होनी चाहिए, तथा BAᵀ परिभाषित होने के लिए B के n स्तंभ होने चाहिए। अतः B की कोटि m × n है। विकल्प (C) सही है।

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या, जिसका उद्देश्य फलन Z = ax + by है, का सुसंगत क्षेत्र एक परिबद्ध क्षेत्र है, तो निम्न में से कौन सा सही है ?
questions.text_english: If the feasible region of a linear programming problem with objective function Z = ax + by, is bounded, then which of the following is correct ?

options.A: It will only have a maximum value.
options.B: It will only have a minimum value.
options.C: It will have both maximum and minimum values.
options.D: It will have neither maximum nor minimum value.

options_english.A: It will only have a maximum value.
options_english.B: It will only have a minimum value.
options_english.C: It will have both maximum and minimum values.
options_english.D: It will have neither maximum nor minimum value.

questions.solution: By the fundamental theorem of linear programming, if the feasible region is bounded (closed and finite), then the objective function Z = ax + by attains both a maximum value and a minimum value at the corner points of the feasible region. Hence option C is correct. Options A and B are incorrect because a bounded region guarantees both extremes, not just one.
questions.solution_hindi: रैखिक प्रोग्रामन के मूलभूत प्रमेय के अनुसार, यदि सुसंगत क्षेत्र परिबद्ध है, तो उद्देश्य फलन का अधिकतम तथा न्यूनतम दोनों मान होते हैं। विकल्प (C) सही है।

questions.solution: The given matrix A is a diagonal matrix with entries −1, 1, 1 on the diagonal. For a diagonal matrix, the inverse is obtained by taking the reciprocal of each diagonal element. The reciprocal of −1 is −1, and the reciprocal of 1 is 1. Therefore A⁻¹ = [[-1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]] = A itself. This means A is its own inverse (an involutory matrix). Option D is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: A एक विकर्ण आव्यूह है जिसके विकर्ण अवयव −1, 1, 1 हैं। इसका व्युत्क्रम प्रत्येक विकर्ण अवयव का व्युत्क्रम लेने पर मिलता है: A⁻¹ = [[-1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]] = A। विकल्प (D) सही है।

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण dy/dx + y = (1 + y)/x का समाकलन गुणक है :
questions.text_english: The integrating factor of the differential equation dy/dx + y = (1 + y)/x is :
questions.solution: Rewrite the equation: dy/dx + y = (1+y)/x = 1/x + y/x. So dy/dx + y − y/x = 1/x, giving dy/dx + y(1 − 1/x) = 1/x. Here P = 1 − 1/x. The integrating factor is e^(∫P dx) = e^(∫(1 − 1/x) dx) = e^(x − ln x) = e^x · e^(−ln x) = e^x/x. Wait, that gives e^x/x which is option B. Let me re-examine the equation: dy/dx + y = (1+y)/x. Rearranging: dy/dx + y − y/x = 1/x, so dy/dx + y(1 − 1/x) = 1/x. IF = e^(∫(1−1/x)dx) = e^(x − ln x) = e^x/x. Option B is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: समीकरण को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करने पर dy/dx + y(1 − 1/x) = 1/x मिलता है। P = 1 − 1/x, अतः समाकलन गुणक = e^(x − ln x) = e^x/x। विकल्प (B) सही है।

questions.text: माना A = [aᵢⱼ] एक कोटि 3 का वर्ग आव्यूह है जिसमें aᵢⱼ = ĵ − 2î है, तो निम्न में से कौन सा सही है ?
questions.text_english: Let A = [aᵢⱼ] be a square matrix of order 3 such that aᵢⱼ = j − 2i. Then which of the following is true ?
questions.solution: Using aᵢⱼ = j − 2i: a₁₂ = 2 − 2 = 0 (not > 0, so A is wrong). a₁₁ = 1−2 = −1, a₁₃ = 3−2 = 1 > 0 (so not all < 0, B is wrong). a₁₃ = 3 − 2(1) = 1, a₃₁ = 1 − 2(3) = −5, so a₁₃ + a₃₁ = 1 + (−5) = −4, not −6 — let me recheck. Actually, aᵢⱼ = j − 2i: a₁₃ = 3 − 2×1 = 1, a₃₁ = 1 − 2×3 = −5. Sum = −4. a₂₃ = 3−4 = −1, a₃₂ = 2−6 = −4. So a₂₃ = −1 > a₃₂ = −4. Option D is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: aᵢⱼ = j − 2i से: a₂₃ = 3 − 4 = −1, a₃₂ = 2 − 6 = −4। अतः a₂₃ > a₃₂। विकल्प (D) सही है।

questions.text: फलन f(x) = x³ − 3x + 2 का [0, 2] में निरपेक्ष उच्चतम मान है :
questions.text_english: The absolute maximum value of function f(x) = x³ − 3x + 2 in [0, 2] is :
questions.solution: To find the absolute maximum of f(x) = x³ − 3x + 2 on [0, 2], we find critical points: f'(x) = 3x² − 3 = 0 gives x² = 1, so x = 1 (x = −1 is outside the interval). Now evaluate: f(0) = 0 − 0 + 2 = 2, f(1) = 1 − 3 + 2 = 0, f(2) = 8 − 6 + 2 = 4. The absolute maximum value is 4 at x = 2. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: f'(x) = 3x² − 3 = 0 से x = 1 क्रांतिक बिंदु है। f(0) = 2, f(1) = 0, f(2) = 4। अतः निरपेक्ष उच्चतम मान 4 है। विकल्प (C) सही है।

questions.text: यदि ∫(2^(1/x))/x² dx = k · 2^(1/x) + C है, तो k बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If ∫(2^(1/x))/x² dx = k · 2^(1/x) + C, then k is equal to :
questions.solution: Let t = 1/x, then dt = −1/x² dx, so (1/x²)dx = −dt. The integral becomes ∫2^t · (−dt) = −∫2^t dt = −2^t/log 2 + C = −(1/log 2) · 2^(1/x) + C. Comparing with k · 2^(1/x) + C, we get k = −1/log 2. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: t = 1/x रखने पर dt = −(1/x²)dx। समाकल = −∫2^t dt = −2^t/log 2 + C = −(1/log 2)·2^(1/x) + C। अतः k = −1/log 2। विकल्प (A) सही है।

questions.text: यदि A तथा B व्युत्क्रमणीय आव्यूह हैं, तो निम्न में से कौन सा सही नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: If A and B are invertible matrices, then which of the following is not correct ?
questions.solution: Option A states (A + B)⁻¹ = B⁻¹ + A⁻¹, which is generally false for matrices. The inverse of a sum is not equal to the sum of inverses. Option B is a standard result: (AB)⁻¹ = B⁻¹A⁻¹. Option C is the standard relation adj(A) = |A|A⁻¹. Option D follows from the property that det(A⁻¹) = 1/det(A) = |A|⁻¹. Therefore option A is the incorrect statement.
questions.solution_hindi: (A + B)⁻¹ = B⁻¹ + A⁻¹ आव्यूहों के लिए सामान्यतः असत्य है। यह आव्यूह बीजगणित का एक मान्य नियम नहीं है। विकल्प (A) गलत है।

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामिंग समस्या के आलेखीय निरूपण के सुसंगत क्षेत्र के कोनीय शीर्ष (2, 72), (15, 20) और (40, 15) हैं। यदि Z = 18x + 9y इसका उद्देश्य फलन है, तो :
questions.text_english: The corner points of the feasible region in graphical representation of a L.P.P. are (2, 72), (15, 20) and (40, 15). If Z = 18x + 9y be the objective function, then :

options.A: Z is maximum at (2, 72), minimum at (15, 20)
options.B: Z is maximum at (15, 20) minimum at (40, 15)
options.C: Z is maximum at (40, 15), minimum at (15, 20)
options.D: Z is maximum at (40, 15), minimum at (2, 72)

options_english.A: Z is maximum at (2, 72), minimum at (15, 20)
options_english.B: Z is maximum at (15, 20) minimum at (40, 15)
options_english.C: Z is maximum at (40, 15), minimum at (15, 20)
options_english.D: Z is maximum at (40, 15), minimum at (2, 72)

questions.solution: Evaluate Z = 18x + 9y at each corner point: At (2, 72): Z = 36 + 648 = 684. At (15, 20): Z = 270 + 180 = 450. At (40, 15): Z = 720 + 135 = 855. The maximum value is 855 at (40, 15) and the minimum is 450 at (15, 20). Therefore option C is correct.

questions.text: वक्र y² = x, x = 4 तथा x-अक्ष के बीच के छायांकित क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल प्रदत्त है :
questions.text_english: The area of the shaded region bounded by the curves y² = x, x = 4 and the x-axis is given by :
questions.solution: The parabola y² = x gives y = √x for the upper half. The shaded region is bounded by y = √x (upper branch), x = 4, and the x-axis. The area is ∫₀⁴ √x dx. This integrates the height of the region (which is y = √x) with respect to x from 0 to 4. Option D is correct. Option C would give twice the area (for both halves), which is not shown in the shaded region.
questions.solution_hindi: ऊपरी भाग के लिए y = √x। क्षेत्रफल = ∫₀⁴ √x dx। विकल्प (D) सही है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : माना Z पूर्णांकों का समुच्चय है। एक फलन f : Z → Z, जो f(x) = 3x − 5, ∀x ∈ Z द्वारा परिभाषित है, एकैकी-आच्छादक है।
तर्क (R) : वह फलन जो एकैकी है तथा आच्छादक भी है, एकैकी-आच्छादक होता है।

questions.solution: Assertion (A): f(x) = 3x − 5 from Z to Z. For injectivity: if 3x₁ − 5 = 3x₂ − 5, then x₁ = x₂, so f is injective. For surjectivity: for any y ∈ Z, we need x = (y + 5)/3 ∈ Z. But (y + 5) is not always divisible by 3 (e.g., y = 0 gives x = 5/3 ∉ Z). So f is NOT surjective, hence NOT bijective. Assertion A is false. Reason R states that a function is bijective if it is both surjective and injective — this is the correct definition, so Reason R is true. Therefore option D is correct.

questions.text_english:
(a) Two friends while flying kites from different locations, find the strings of their kites crossing each other. The strings can be represented by vectors a = 3î + ĵ + 2k̂ and b = 2î − 2ĵ + 4k̂. Determine the angle formed between the kite strings. Assume there is no slack in the strings.

OR

(b) Find a vector of magnitude 21 units in the direction opposite to that of AB where A and B are the points A(2, 1, 3) and B(8, −1, 0) respectively.

key_points: (b) AB = (6, −2, −3); |AB| = √(36+4+9) = 7; unit vector opposite to AB = −(1/7)(6î−2ĵ−3k̂); vector of magnitude 21 = 21×(−1/7)(6î−2ĵ−3k̂) = −3(6î−2ĵ−3k̂) = −18î+6ĵ+9k̂

questions.solution:
(a) The angle θ between the two kite strings is given by cos θ = (a·b)/(|a||b|). Computing the dot product: a·b = (3)(2) + (1)(−2) + (2)(4) = 6 − 2 + 8 = 12. Magnitudes: |a| = √(9+1+4) = √14 and |b| = √(4+4+16) = √24 = 2√6. Therefore cos θ = 12/(√14 · 2√6) = 12/(2√84) = 6/√84 = 3/√21. So the angle between the kite strings is θ = cos⁻¹(3/√21).

(b) Vector AB = B − A = (8−2)î + (−1−1)ĵ + (0−3)k̂ = 6î − 2ĵ − 3k̂. |AB| = √(36+4+9) = √49 = 7. The unit vector opposite to AB is −(1/7)(6î − 2ĵ − 3k̂). The required vector of magnitude 21 in the direction opposite to AB is 21 × (−1/7)(6î − 2ĵ − 3k̂) = −3(6î − 2ĵ − 3k̂) = −18î + 6ĵ + 9k̂.

key_points: f'(x) = 2x − 2a ≥ 0 for all x > 0

questions.solution: For f(x) = x² − 2ax + b to be an increasing function for x > 0, we need f'(x) ≥ 0 for all x > 0. Differentiating, f'(x) = 2x − 2a. For f to be increasing, 2x − 2a ≥ 0, i.e., x ≥ a for all x > 0. Since this must hold for all x > 0, including values of x approaching 0 from the right, we need a ≤ 0. Therefore f(x) is an increasing function for x > 0 when a ≤ 0.

questions.solution: The principal range of sin⁻¹ is [−π/2, π/2]. Since 3π/5 > π/2, it is not in the principal range. We use the identity sin(π − θ) = sin θ: sin(3π/5) = sin(π − 3π/5) = sin(2π/5). Now 2π/5 lies in [−π/2, π/2]. Therefore sin⁻¹(sin(3π/5)) = sin⁻¹(sin(2π/5)) = 2π/5.

questions.solution: The area of a parallelogram whose diagonals are represented by vectors a and b is given by Area = (1/2)|a × b|. Computing the cross product: a × b = |î ĵ k̂; 2 −1 1; 1 3 −1| = î((−1)(−1) − (1)(3)) − ĵ((2)(−1) − (1)(1)) + k̂((2)(3) − (−1)(1)) = î(1−3) − ĵ(−2−1) + k̂(6+1) = −2î + 3ĵ + 7k̂. Therefore |a × b| = √(4 + 9 + 49) = √62. The area of the parallelogram is (1/2)√62 square units.

key_points: (a) Line 1: point (1,−2,3), direction (−1,1,−2); Line 2: point (1,−1,−1), direction (1,2,−2); Check coplanarity using scalar triple product; SD = |((a₂−a₁)·(d₁×d₂))|/|d₁×d₂|

questions.solution:
(a) From the first line: point a₁ = î − 2ĵ + 3k̂, direction d₁ = −î + ĵ − 2k̂. From the second line: point a₂ = î − ĵ − k̂, direction d₂ = î + 2ĵ − 2k̂. Vector a₂ − a₁ = ĵ − 4k̂. Cross product d₁ × d₂ = |î ĵ k̂; −1 1 −2; 1 2 −2| = î(−2+4) − ĵ(2+2) + k̂(−2−1) = 2î − 4ĵ − 3k̂. Scalar triple product (a₂−a₁)·(d₁×d₂) = (0)(2) + (1)(−4) + (−4)(−3) = 0 − 4 + 12 = 8 ≠ 0. Since the scalar triple product is non-zero, the lines are skew. Shortest distance = |8|/√(4+16+9) = 8/√29.

(b) Let W divide BF in ratio k:1. Then W = (kF + B)/(k+1). So 6î + 12ĵ = (k(12î+18ĵ) + 2î+8ĵ)/(k+1). Equating î: 6(k+1) = 12k+2, giving 6k+6 = 12k+2, so 6k = 4, k = 2/3. The ratio BW:WF = 2:3.

questions.text: एक फैलते हुए आयत का क्षेत्रफल 48 cm²/s की दर से बढ़ रहा है। आयत की लंबाई सदैव इसकी चौड़ाई के वर्ग के समान रहती है। आयत की लंबाई के बढ़ने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए, उस वक्त जब इसकी चौड़ाई 4.5 cm हो।
questions.text_english: The area of an expanding rectangle is increasing at the rate of 48 cm²/s. The length of the rectangle is always square of its breadth. At what rate the length of rectangle increasing at an instant, when breadth = 4.5 cm ?

key_points: Let breadth = b, length = b². Area A = b × b² = b³
dA/dt = 3b² · db/dt = 48 when b = 4.5

questions.solution: Let the breadth of the rectangle be b cm. Since the length is always equal to the square of the breadth, the length l = b². The area is A = l × b = b² × b = b³. Differentiating with respect to time: dA/dt = 3b² · db/dt. Given dA/dt = 48 and b = 4.5: 48 = 3(4.5)² · db/dt = 3 × 20.25 × db/dt = 60.75 · db/dt. So db/dt = 48/60.75 = 64/81 cm/s. Now dl/dt = 2b · db/dt = 2 × 4.5 × (64/81) = 9 × 64/81 = 576/81 = 64/9 cm/s. The rate at which the length is increasing when breadth is 4.5 cm is 64/9 cm/s.
questions.solution_hindi: चौड़ाई b, लंबाई l = b², क्षेत्रफल A = b³। dA/dt = 3b²·db/dt = 48, b = 4.5 पर db/dt = 64/81। dl/dt = 2b·db/dt = 64/9 cm/s।

questions.text_english:
(a) Find : ∫cos 2x/(sin x + cos x)² dx

OR

(b) Evaluate : ∫₀^(π/2) (5 sin x + 3 cos x)/(sin x + cos x) dx

key_points: (a) cos 2x = cos²x − sin²x = (cos x − sin x)(cos x + sin x); so integral = ∫(cos x − sin x)/(sin x + cos x) dx = ln|sin x + cos x| + C

(b) Use property: write numerator as A(sin x + cos x) + B(cos x − sin x); 5 sin x + 3 cos x = A(sin x + cos x) + B(cos x − sin x); A=4, B=−1; integral = 4(π/2) + (−1)[ln|sin x + cos x|]₀^(π/2) = 2π + 0 = 2π... standard result gives π + 1

questions.solution:
(a) Note that cos 2x = cos²x − sin²x = (cos x + sin x)(cos x − sin x). Therefore ∫cos 2x/(sin x + cos x)² dx = ∫(cos x + sin x)(cos x − sin x)/(sin x + cos x)² dx = ∫(cos x − sin x)/(sin x + cos x) dx. Let t = sin x + cos x, then dt = (cos x − sin x) dx. The integral becomes ∫dt/t = ln|t| + C = ln|sin x + cos x| + C.

(b) Write 5 sin x + 3 cos x = A(sin x + cos x) + B(d/dx)(sin x + cos x) = A(sin x + cos x) + B(cos x − sin x). Comparing: A − B = 5 and A + B = 3, giving A = 4, B = −1. Therefore ∫₀^(π/2) (5 sin x + 3 cos x)/(sin x + cos x) dx = 4∫₀^(π/2) dx + (−1)∫₀^(π/2) (cos x − sin x)/(sin x + cos x) dx = 4(π/2) − [ln|sin x + cos x|]₀^(π/2) = 2π − (ln 1 − ln 1) = 2π − 0 = 2π. Actually [ln|sin x + cos x|]₀^(π/2) = ln(1) − ln(1) = 0. So the value is 2π.
questions.solution_hindi:
(a) cos 2x = (cos x+sin x)(cos x−sin x)। t = sin x+cos x रखने पर ∫dt/t = ln|sin x + cos x| + C।
(b) 5sin x+3cos x = 4(sin x+cos x) − (cos x−sin x)। ∫₀^(π/2) = 4·π/2 − 0 = 2π।

key_points: y = −(x+3) for x < −3 and y = (x+3) for x ≥ −3
Each integral = 9/2; Total area = 9 sq units

questions.solution: The function y = |x + 3| is a V-shaped graph with vertex at (−3, 0). For x < −3, y = −(x+3) and for x ≥ −3, y = x+3. The area between the curve and the x-axis from x = −6 to x = 0 is: Area = ∫₋₆^(−3) (−(x+3)) dx + ∫₋₃^0 (x+3) dx. First integral: [−x²/2 − 3x]₋₆^(−3) = (−9/2 + 9) − (−18 + 18) = 9/2. Second integral: [x²/2 + 3x]₋₃^0 = 0 − (9/2 − 9) = 9/2. Total area = 9/2 + 9/2 = 9 square units.

अथवा

(b) यदि y = x^(tan x) + √(x²+1)/2 है, तो dy/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Differentiate tan⁻¹(√(1−x²)/x) w.r.t. cos⁻¹(2x√(1−x²)), x ∈ (1/√2, 1).

OR

(b) Find dy/dx, if y = x^(tan x) + √(x²+1)/2.

key_points: (a) Let x = sin θ; tan⁻¹(√(1−x²)/x) = tan⁻¹(cos θ/sin θ) = tan⁻¹(cot θ) = π/2 − θ = π/2 − sin⁻¹x; cos⁻¹(2x√(1−x²)) = cos⁻¹(2sin θ cos θ) = cos⁻¹(sin 2θ) = π/2 − 2θ = π/2 − 2sin⁻¹x; d(π/2−sin⁻¹x)/d(π/2−2sin⁻¹x) = (−1/√(1−x²))/(−2/√(1−x²)) = 1/2

(b) y = x^(tan x) + √(x²+1)/2; for u = x^(tan x): ln u = tan x · ln x; du/dx = x^(tan x)[sec²x·ln x + tan x/x]; for v = √(x²+1)/2: dv/dx = x/(2√(x²+1)); dy/dx = x^(tan x)[sec²x·ln x + tan x/x] + x/(2√(x²+1))

questions.solution:
(a) Let x = sin θ where θ ∈ (π/4, π/2) for x ∈ (1/√2, 1). Then tan⁻¹(√(1−x²)/x) = tan⁻¹(cos θ/sin θ) = tan⁻¹(cot θ) = π/2 − θ = π/2 − sin⁻¹x. Also cos⁻¹(2x√(1−x²)) = cos⁻¹(2 sin θ cos θ) = cos⁻¹(sin 2θ) = cos⁻¹(cos(π/2 − 2θ)) = π/2 − 2θ = π/2 − 2sin⁻¹x. Let u = π/2 − sin⁻¹x and v = π/2 − 2sin⁻¹x. Then du/dx = −1/√(1−x²) and dv/dx = −2/√(1−x²). Therefore du/dv = (du/dx)/(dv/dx) = (−1/√(1−x²))/(−2/√(1−x²)) = 1/2.

(b) Let u = x^(tan x) and v = √(x²+1)/2. For u: taking log, ln u = tan x · ln x. Differentiating: (1/u)(du/dx) = sec²x · ln x + tan x · (1/x). So du/dx = x^(tan x)[sec²x · ln x + (tan x)/x]. For v: dv/dx = (2x)/(2 · 2√(x²+1)) = x/(2√(x²+1)). Therefore dy/dx = x^(tan x)[sec²x · ln x + (tan x)/x] + x/(2√(x²+1)).
questions.solution_hindi:
(a) x = sin θ रखने पर दोनों फलनों को सरल करने पर du/dv = 1/2।
(b) u = x^(tan x) के लिए log लेकर अवकलन करने पर du/dx = x^(tan x)[sec²x · ln x + tan x/x] तथा v = √(x²+1)/2 के लिए dv/dx = x/(2√(x²+1))। अतः dy/dx = x^(tan x)[sec²x·ln x + tan x/x] + x/(2√(x²+1))।

questions.text_english: Find the absolute maximum and absolute minimum of function f(x) = 2x³ − 15x² + 36x + 1 on [1, 5].

key_points: Critical points in [1,5]: x = 2 and x = 3
Absolute maximum = 56 at x = 5; Absolute minimum = 24 at x = 1

questions.solution: To find absolute maximum and minimum of f(x) = 2x³ − 15x² + 36x + 1 on [1, 5], we first find f'(x) = 6x² − 30x + 36 = 6(x² − 5x + 6) = 6(x−2)(x−3). Setting f'(x) = 0 gives critical points x = 2 and x = 3, both in [1, 5]. Now evaluate f at the critical points and endpoints: f(1) = 2 − 15 + 36 + 1 = 24; f(2) = 16 − 60 + 72 + 1 = 29; f(3) = 54 − 135 + 108 + 1 = 28; f(5) = 250 − 375 + 180 + 1 = 56. Comparing all values, the absolute maximum is 56 at x = 5 and the absolute minimum is 24 at x = 1.

• इन तीनों क्लबों में आबंटित विद्यार्थियों की कुल संख्या 180 हो।
मैट्रिक विधि द्वारा विभिन्न क्लबों में आबंटित विद्यार्थियों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
A school wants to allocate students into three clubs: Sports, Music and Drama, under following conditions:
• The number of students in Sports club should be equal to the sum of the number of students in Music and Drama club.
• The number of students in Music club should be 20 more than half the number of students in Sports club.
• The total number of students to be allocated in all three clubs are 180.
Find the number of students allocated to different clubs, using matrix method.

key_points: Let Sports = x, Music = y, Drama = z
From equation 1: x − y − z = 0; From equation 2: x − 2y = −40; Equation 3: x+y+z = 180
Matrix form AX = B; solve using A⁻¹

questions.solution: Let x = number of students in Sports, y = Music, z = Drama. The conditions give: x = y + z → x − y − z = 0 ... (i); y = x/2 + 20 → x − 2y = −40 ... (ii); x + y + z = 180 ... (iii). In matrix form AX = B where A = [[1,−1,−1],[1,−2,0],[1,1,1]], X = [x,y,z]ᵀ, B = [0,−40,180]ᵀ. Computing det(A): expanding along row 1, det(A) = 1(−2−0) − (−1)(1−0) + (−1)(1+2) = −2 + 1 − 3 = −4. Finding A⁻¹ and solving AX = B gives x = 90, y = 65, z = 25. Therefore Sports club has 90 students, Music club has 65 students, and Drama club has 25 students.
questions.solution_hindi: मान लीजिए खेल = x, संगीत = y, नाटक = z। समीकरण: x−y−z=0, x−2y=−40, x+y+z=180। आव्यूह विधि से हल करने पर x = 90, y = 65, z = 25।

questions.text: एक बैंक अपने ग्राहकों को विभिन्न प्रकार के ब्याज पर ऋण उपलब्ध कराता है, जैसे कि फिक्स्ड दर, फ्लोटिंग दर और वेरिएबल दर। बैंक के पिछले आँकड़ों से यह ज्ञात है कि ग्राहक फिक्स्ड दर, फ्लोटिंग दर या वेरिएबल दर पर क्रमश: 10%, 20% और 70% प्रायिकता के साथ ऋण प्राप्त करते हैं। ऋण लेने के बाद ग्राहक ऋण का भुगतान कर सकता है या ऋण चुकाने में चूक भी कर सकता है। बैंक के आँकड़ों से पता चलता है कि फिक्स्ड रेट, फ्लोटिंग रेट और वेरिएबल रेट पर ऋण लेने के बाद किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा ऋण भुगतान पर चूक करने की प्रायिकता क्रमश: 5%, 3% और 1% है।
questions.text_english:
A bank offers loan to its customers on different types of interest namely, fixed rate, floating rate and variable rate. From the past data with the bank, it is known that a customer avails loan on fixed rate, floating rate or variable rate with probabilities 10%, 20% and 70% respectively. A customer after availing loan can pay the loan or default on loan repayment. The bank data suggests that the probability that a person defaults on loan after availing it at fixed rate, floating rate and variable rate is 5%, 3% and 1% respectively.

Based on the above information, answer the following:
(i) What is the probability that a customer after availing the loan will default on the loan repayment?
(ii) A customer after availing the loan, defaults on loan repayment. What is the probability that he availed the loan at a variable rate of interest?
questions.instruction_line: उपरोक्त के आधार पर निम्न के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following.

sub_questions.text: ऋण लेने के बाद एक ग्राहक के ऋण चुकाने में चूक करने की क्या प्रायिकता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that a customer after availing the loan will default on the loan repayment ?
sub_questions.solution: Using the total probability theorem: P(Default) = P(Fixed)×P(D|Fixed) + P(Floating)×P(D|Floating) + P(Variable)×P(D|Variable) = 0.10×0.05 + 0.20×0.03 + 0.70×0.01 = 0.005 + 0.006 + 0.007 = 0.018. The probability that a customer will default on loan repayment is 0.018.

sub_questions.text: एक ग्राहक ऋण लेने के बाद चुकाने में चूक करता है। क्या प्रायिकता है कि उसने वेरिएबल दर ब्याज पर ऋण लिया था ?
sub_questions.text_english: A customer after availing the loan, defaults on loan repayment. What is the probability that he availed the loan at a variable rate of interest ?

key_points: P(Variable|Default) = P(Variable)×P(D|Variable)/P(Default) = 0.007/0.018 = 7/18

sub_questions.solution: Using Bayes' theorem: P(Variable|Default) = P(Variable)×P(D|Variable)/P(Default) = (0.70×0.01)/0.018 = 0.007/0.018 = 7/18. Given that a customer has defaulted, the probability that he had taken the loan at a variable rate is 7/18.

questions.solution: Case study on Bayes' theorem. Answers are provided in sub_questions: (i) P(Default) = 0.018; (ii) P(Variable|Default) = 7/18.

questions.text: एक टेक्निकल कंपनी आयताकार सौर पैनल बना रही है जिन्हें छत पर लगाने के लिए उसके पास 300 मीटर सीमा पर लगाने की सामग्री है। पैनल के डिजाइन में एक साइड के समांतर विभाजन है जो पैनल को दो भागों में बाँटता है। माना विभाजन के लंबवत वाली भुजा की लंबाई x मीटर तथा इसके समांतर वाली भुजा की लंबाई y मीटर है।
questions.text_english:
A technical company is designing a rectangular solar panel installation on a roof using 300 metres of boundary material. The design includes a partition running parallel to one of the sides dividing the area (roof) into two sections.
Let the length of the side perpendicular to the partition be x metres and with parallel to the partition be y metres.

Based on this information, answer the following questions:
(i) Write the equation for the total boundary material used in the boundary and parallel to the partition in terms of x and y.
(ii) Write the area of the solar panel as a function of x.
(iii)(a) Find the critical points of the area function. Use second derivative test to determine critical points at the maximum area. Also, find the maximum area.
OR
(iii)(b) Using first derivative test, calculate the maximum area the company can enclose with the 300 metres of boundary material, considering the parallel partition.

sub_questions.text: सीमा की कुल सामग्री जो सीमा तथा समांतर विभाजन में प्रयोग होनी है, के प्रयोग से x तथा y में बनी समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the equation for the total boundary material used in the boundary and parallel to the partition in terms of x and y.

key_points: 3x + 2y = 300 (two sides of length x, two sides of length y, plus one partition of length y... actually 2 sides x and 3 sides y: 2x + 3y = 300)

sub_questions.solution: The rectangular panel has two sides of length x (perpendicular to partition) and two sides of length y (parallel to partition), plus one internal partition of length y. Total boundary material = 2x + 3y = 300.

sub_questions.text: सौर पैनल का क्षेत्रफल x के फलन के रूप में लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the area of the solar panel as a function of x.

sub_questions.text: क्षेत्रफल फलन के क्रांतिक बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए। द्वितीय अवकलज के प्रयोग से वह क्रांतिक बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए जिस पर क्षेत्रफल अधिकतम है। अधिकतम क्षेत्रफल भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the critical points of the area function. Use second derivative test to determine critical points at the maximum area. Also, find the maximum area.
sub_questions.solution: A(x) = (300x − 2x²)/3. Differentiating: A'(x) = (300 − 4x)/3. Setting A'(x) = 0: 300 − 4x = 0, so x = 75. Second derivative: A''(x) = −4/3 < 0, confirming x = 75 is a maximum. Maximum area = A(75) = (300×75 − 2×75²)/3 = (22500 − 11250)/3 = 11250/3 = 3750 square metres.

sub_questions.text: प्रथम अवकलज परीक्षण के प्रयोग से 300 मीटर सीमा सामग्री के प्रयोग से परिबद्ध अधिकतम क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जहाँ समांतर विभाजन को भी लिया गया है।
sub_questions.text_english: Using first derivative test, calculate the maximum area the company can enclose with the 300 metres of boundary material, considering the parallel partition.

key_points: A'(x) = (300−4x)/3; for x < 75, A'(x) > 0 (increasing); for x > 75, A'(x) < 0 (decreasing); so x = 75 is a maximum by first derivative test; Maximum area = 3750 sq m

sub_questions.solution: A'(x) = (300 − 4x)/3. For x < 75, (300 − 4x) > 0 so A'(x) > 0 (A is increasing). For x > 75, (300 − 4x) < 0 so A'(x) < 0 (A is decreasing). Since A'(x) changes from positive to negative at x = 75, by the first derivative test, x = 75 gives the maximum area. Maximum area = A(75) = (300×75 − 2×5625)/3 = 11250/3 = 3750 square metres.

questions.solution: Case study on applications of derivatives for optimization. Answers are in sub_questions.

sub_questions.text: संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए जो स्वतुल्य और संक्रामक है परन्तु सममित नहीं है।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify the relation which is reflexive, transitive but not symmetric.

key_points: R₄ = {(1,1),(1,2),(3,3),(2,2)} is reflexive (has (1,1),(2,2),(3,3)), transitive (1,2 is in R₄; need (1,2) implies checking transitivity — satisfied), but not symmetric since (1,2) ∈ R₄ but (2,1) ∉ R₄

sub_questions.solution: R₄ = {(1,1),(1,2),(3,3),(2,2)} is reflexive since (1,1), (2,2), (3,3) are all present. It is transitive: the only non-diagonal pair is (1,2); since (1,2) is in R₄ and (2,?) — (2,1), (2,2), (2,3) are not in R₄ except (2,2), so transitivity holds. It is not symmetric since (1,2) ∈ R₄ but (2,1) ∉ R₄. Therefore R₄ is reflexive and transitive but not symmetric.

sub_questions.text: संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए जो स्वतुल्य और सममित है परन्तु संक्रामक नहीं है।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify the relation which is reflexive and symmetric but not transitive.

key_points: R₅ is reflexive (has (1,1),(2,2),(3,3)), symmetric (has both (1,2)&(2,1), (2,3)&(3,2)), but not transitive: (1,2)∈R₅ and (2,3)∈R₅ but (1,3)∉R₅

sub_questions.solution: R₅ = {(1,1),(1,2),(3,3),(2,2),(2,1),(2,3),(3,2)} is reflexive since (1,1),(2,2),(3,3) are present. It is symmetric since for every (a,b) in R₅, (b,a) is also present: (1,2) and (2,1) both present; (2,3) and (3,2) both present. It is NOT transitive: (1,2) ∈ R₅ and (2,3) ∈ R₅, but (1,3) ∉ R₅. Therefore R₅ is reflexive and symmetric but not transitive.

sub_questions.text_english: Identify the relations which are symmetric but neither reflexive nor transitive.

key_points: R₁ = {(2,3),(3,2)} is symmetric (has both (2,3) and (3,2)), not reflexive (no (1,1),(2,2),(3,3)), not transitive ((2,3)∈R₁ and (3,2)∈R₁ but (2,2)∉R₁)

sub_questions.solution: R₁ = {(2,3),(3,2)} is symmetric since (2,3) ∈ R₁ and (3,2) ∈ R₁. It is NOT reflexive since (1,1), (2,2), (3,3) are all absent. It is NOT transitive: (2,3) ∈ R₁ and (3,2) ∈ R₁, but (2,2) ∉ R₁. Therefore R₁ is symmetric but neither reflexive nor transitive.

sub_questions.text_english: What pairs should be added to the relation R₂ to make it an equivalence relation ?
sub_questions.solution: R₂ = {(1,2),(1,3),(3,2)}. For R₂ to be an equivalence relation, it must be reflexive, symmetric, and transitive. Reflexivity requires adding (1,1), (2,2), (3,3). Symmetry requires adding (2,1), (3,1), (2,3) corresponding to existing pairs (1,2), (1,3), (3,2). After adding these, we check transitivity: all necessary pairs are covered. Therefore the pairs to be added are (1,1), (2,2), (3,3), (2,1), (3,1), and (2,3).
